description: This bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in accuracy for different hidden layer configurations. The horizontal axis displays the hidden layer configurations, labeled “hidden:[], linear”, “hidden:[100], linear”, “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”, and “hidden:[100], ReLU”, presented in a non-alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the percentage point difference in accuracy, labeled “% point difference”, with a linear scale ranging from -0.1 to 0.2, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. Four blue bars are displayed, each corresponding to a hidden layer configuration; the bar for “hidden:[], linear” reaches approximately 0.05, the bar for “hidden:[100], linear” reaches approximately -0.05, the bar for “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU” reaches approximately 0.15, and the bar for “hidden:[100], ReLU” reaches approximately 0.2. No bars are visually emphasized, and there is no grouping or stacking of bars.
